prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the long earrings fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult woman, mid 20s, with the glamorous Y2K 'Bratz' glam look: warm golden-tan skin with real visible pores and a shimmering highlight on the cheekbones, long sleek straight jet-black hair with orange streaks past her shoulders. Her eyes are huge, wide, saucer-shaped almond eyes, extra-large with a big visible iris in vivid honey-amber big-iris contact lenses, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights, framed by very bold, thick, long lashes and heavy pink-and-gold shimmer eyeshadow with a sharp winged liner, and thin, high, sharply arched brows. Her lips are extremely plump, big, glossy hot-pink lips with a darker pink lip liner outline and a pronounced cupid's bow, slightly pouting. A small, narrow, upturned nose, high sculpted cheekbones, and a small pointed chin. A sassy, confident, playful look straight into the camera. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain and a soft sheen of natural oils, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about one hundred and thirty-three in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: three separate septum rings of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; four small rings wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; ten small ring or studs on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding a huge dome-shaped bell earring as large as her palm, with rows of tiny gem and pearl drops hanging from its rim, hanging freely in the air down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit twenty-nine pieces above the lobe: fourteen classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim, nine studs and small bars across the upper cartilage and six in the conch and tragus; twenty small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; sixteen small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The pieces on her face are punk in style: instead of plain studs and rings, the small pieces are safety-pin shaped bars, sharp cone-spike studs and chunky chain-link rings. The left and right sides are balanced. The piercings are packed so densely that the rows touch and overlap, leaving only hairline gaps of bare skin between them, until the face reads as a single armour of metal; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. The face and ear jewelry is real blackened steel and chrome silver, spiked and studded, with no gemstones, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: A plain seamless deep teal backdrop, nothing else in frame, no texture, no gradient. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from her skin tone, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
